item.description:
Clicks and highlights work again
- Rows in the list open their card when clicked, and the lit row follows the pointer instead of staying on one it left - The list opens on its top row, even with the pointer resting over another one - Selecting what the agent said no longer flickers, and buttons on a card answer the first click - Got it after What's new goes on to the list

Start a session from the notch, and copy what the agent said
- Command+Option+N, or New session in the list, starts a session in Claude, Codex or your terminal while you stay where you were - What the agent said, on the card or in a reply, can be selected and copied with Command+C - A card with words selected stays open, so you can copy at your own pace - After an update, a What's new card says what changed - Highlights in the list and in Settings follow the pointer and never stay lit after it leaves

Answers say Sent, and Perch works with Conductor and Warp
- An answer from the notch or a card now says Sent with a paper plane, or Didn't send if it reached nothing - Conductor workspaces show up in the list and Pick up opens them in Conductor - Pick up in Warp lands on the session's tab
